# Create an Embed Job

POST https://api.cohere.com/v1/embed-jobs

Available models and corresponding embedding dimensions:

- `embed-english-v3.0`: 1024 - `embed-multilingual-v3.0`: 1024 - `embed-english-light-v3.0`: 384 - `embed-multilingual-light-v3.0`: 384

- `dataset_id`: The dataset to embed. Accepted types are `embed-input` and `embed-output`.
